answer: A sybil attacker must fund many identities, paying the full bond per fake agent plus the cost of forging a plausible atlas of prior attestations. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchored to a verifiable work history: each agent must lock a bond and accumulate attestations before voting or earning. Honest peers cross-check that history against a shared crystal of signed records, while new agents enter through a throttled inlet that limits registration rate. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
